The company offers repainted steel, galvanized steel, chromate-free treated steel, and cold rolled products; building material, such as roofing products, siding products, rooftop greenery systems, solar power generation systems, and installation of roofing and siding; exterior products, including storage sheds, houses, carports, garages, warehouses, trash bins, and bicycle parks; Rolls comprising large machinery components that support manufacturing, including paper, packaging film, and rubber and steel; yodo water falls (overflow-suppression grating), yodo karugaru grating, yodo ex grating, yodo galfan grating, and other gratings; household equipment, household implements, and building materials. It also provides design and contracting construction work, warehousing, packaging and shipping, sale, purchase and leasing of real estate, building of produce cultivation facilities and landscaping, and associated business activities. Yodoko, Ltd. was formerly known as Yodogawa Steel Works, Ltd. and changed its name to Yodoko, Ltd. in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 1935 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

stocks.name: インフロニア・ホールディングス
stocks.businessSummary: INFRONEER Holdings Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides infrastructure services in Japan. The company operates through three segments: Building Construction; Civil Engineering; and Paving. It provides constructed on work and related business for multi-dwelling complexes, factories and logistics centers, bridges and tunnels. The company is also involved in manufacturing and sale of asphalt mixture, and related businesses; providing construction work, including pavement; and sales and rental of construction machinery and related businesses. In addition, it engages in business investment in the development, operation, and maintenance; sale of solar and wind power generation projects; and concession projects, such as acquisition of operating rights for public infrastructure, etc. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

stocks.name: ブリッジインターナショナルグループ
stocks.businessSummary: BRIDGE International Group Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of corporate sale services in Japan. It operates through Inside Sales Outsourcing Business, Process Technology Business, and Training segments. The company offers consulting services, such as revenue process, marketing process, inside sales process, field sales process, customer success process design and optimization, as well as RevOps launch and optimization; and marketing, inside sales, and customer success field outsourcing and operations services. It also provides Tech Stack comprising Rev Tech, MarTech, Sales Tech, and Customer Tech selection, implementation, and utilization support services; and role-specific training in the sales process. The company was formerly known as BRIDGE International Corp. and changed its name to BRIDGE International Group Corp. in October 2025. BRIDGE International Group Corp. was incorporated in 2002 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

stocks.name: ディップ
stocks.businessSummary: DIP Corporation engages in the human resources service business in Japan and the United States. The company offers dip AI, a dialogue-based part-time job search service; Baitoru talk, a communication app for store managers and part-time employees; Baitoru, a portal website for part time employees; Spot Baitoru, a job matching service that connects people who want to work in their spare time with establishments looking for workers; Baitoru NEXT, a job information website for those who are looking to work as regular or contract employees; Baitoru PRO, a job information site for specialized jobs; Hatarako net, a portal website connecting companies with those seeking regular, dispatched or part-time employment; Nurse de Hatarako, a job agency website for nurses; and Kaigo de Hatarako, a job agency website for care worker. It also provides Interview KOBOT, which handles accepting applications, and setting interview dates and times on behalf of the hiring manager; Personnel Administration KOBOT, a digital labor force that automates routine task; Corporate Recruiting Page KOBOT, a staff recruitment page for each client; HR KOBOT for Application Support; HR KOBOT which provides application support; Patronage KOBOT, a digital membership card service to attract regular customers with LINE Mini Apps; MEO KOBOT, a service to rank higher in map searches and boost customer acquisition; Baitoru magazine, an information platform that for finding part-time jobs and changing careers; Hatarako magazine, an information source for finding new working styles; AINOW, an AI-specialized media; dip Research Institute; and dip people. DIP Corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

stocks.name: エスケーエレクトロニクス
stocks.businessSummary: SK-Electronics CO.,LTD. manufactures and sells large-format photomasks in Japan and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Service Business and Solution Business. The company provides photomasks for use in liquid crystal displays, plasma display panel, OLEDs, TSPs, semiconductor packages, light guides, micro electromechanical systems, and other components and tools for equipment inspections. It also offers radio frequency identification products; and healthcare/medical devices, including electrical stimulators and stethoscopes and percussion hammers. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.
